name: AWS-Cloud-Challenge
description: AWS Cloud Challenge for learning AWS tools and functions.

paragraphs: Hola! This project implements the AWS Cloud Resume Challenge, a hands-on project designed by Forrest Brazeal ( to demonstrate practical cloud skills using AWS. My primary motivation for undertaking this challenge was to gain a deeper understanding of DevOps principles, specifically from a cybersecurity perspective. By building and deploying this online resume website, I aimed to explore how security can be integrated throughout the development and deployment lifecycle.
